```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/ajl21/github/division.labor/Evolution_desiccation/")
#data: Turbidity 0 alive 1 death; Did not track same cultures over time just replicates
data <- read.csv("20261012_1127_coculture_des_ArgTrp.csv")
data$Replicate <- c(rep(1:4))

```




```{r}

data$Time_factor <- factor(data$Time)

fit <- glm(
  Event ~ Strain * Time_factor,
  data = data,
  family = binomial
)

anova(fit, test = "Chisq")

```


```{r}
plot_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Strain, Time) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    events = sum(Event),
    proportion = mean(Event),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_data$Strain <- dplyr::recode(
  plot_data$Strain,
  "ARGsTRPs" = "Arg(S) + Trp(S)",
  "ARGsTRPw" = "Arg(S) + Trp(WT)",
  "ARGwTRPs" = "Arg(WT) + Trp(S)",
  "ARGwTRPw" = "Arg(WT) + Trp(WT)"
)

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = Time, y = proportion,
           color = Strain, group = Strain)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (hours)",
    y = "Morality Rate",
    color = "Strain"
  ) +
scale_color_grey()


```
